_comment: M28.5.3 set_eqs_generator_property post-apply inspection + soak. Fourth M28.5 EQS write-side op. Duplicates EQS_BpxTestWithOption (pre-seeded with one option carrying an EnvQueryGenerator_ActorsOfClass generator + one EnvQueryTest_Random test) into a scratch path and mutates the option's generator's OptionName FString — a base-class UEnvQueryGenerator UPROPERTY that the M15 EnvQueryDeepRenderer surfaces both in the per-option header (`### Option 0 — \`BpxGenRenamed\``) AND in the generator UPROPERTY table. Asserts the new value appears in .deep.md so the inspect gate catches any ExportText round-trip regression. Soak exercises the shared SetPropertyValue bridge's idempotent short-circuit (before == value after round 1) — no NewObject in this op, so determinism is by construction; the soak gate protects against accidental non-idempotent mutations sneaking in (e.g. if the save path introduced an autogenerated field). Targets option[0].Generator.OptionName by nested-path navigation through the reflection bridge: path = ["Options", "[0]", "Generator", "OptionName"].
